senses.gloss: f. (תָּקַן, v. תְּקָנָה) amendment, i.e. a rabbinical measure to prevent transgression of a law.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:11:2">Y. Succ. III, end, 54ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ אחר ה׳</he> a rabbinical measure to fortify a rabbinical measure; cmp. <cite ref="C00553"><he>גְּזֵירָה</he></cite>.
